name: University of South Bohemia in České Budějovice
summary: Founded in 1991 in České Budějovice; one English bachelor's, Biological Chemistry, a double degree shared with JKU Linz in Austria.

ib.text: USB assesses a foreign school-leaving certificate that gives university access at home without nostrification; the Faculty of Science charges CZK 990 to assess it. Admission is by a chemistry and maths test.

programmes.name: Biological Chemistry
programmes.about: Chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, biophysics and bioinformatics, with a large share of lab work, split about half and half between České Budějovice and JKU Linz; you write two theses and earn two bachelor's degrees.
programmes.ib: Written entrance test in chemistry and mathematics (50% needed in each), or SCIO test results instead; a STEM grade average is checked first.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the chemistry and maths test, or a SCIO percentile of 70+; olympiads or AP scores of 3–5 can waive the test. 20 places via USB. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Your first year is in Linz, so if you need a visa, apply for it in Austria, not Czechia.
Last year proof of finishing school was due just before the June exam, ahead of IB results: ask the faculty early how to send yours.
More places go through JKU Linz, which runs its own application for the same programme.
